shared_elements: low-relief carving on a rounded rock surface
justification: The only real correspondence is a circular disc motif (a concentric ring on A, a winged disc crowning the panel on B) and a general division of the field by horizontal lines, both of which are near-universal. B depicts a coherent figural scene of standing human figures beneath an arched frame above dense rows of written signs, whereas A shows only isolated abstract bosses, loops and curved bands with no figures, no text and no framing panel.
